mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_aftersale_note(case_id, user_id, note, evidence_ids) VALUES(#{caseId}, #{userId}, #{note}, #{evidence})
mapper.select: SELECT applicant_id FROM vi_aftersale_case WHERE id = #{caseId} AND applicant_type = 'ACCOUNT' UNION SELECT o.owner_account_id FROM vi_aftersale_case c JOIN vi_order o ON o.id = c.order_id WHERE c.id = #{caseId} UNION SELECT account_id FROM vi_aftersale_note WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND account_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT phone_lookup FROM vi_account WHERE id = #{accountId} AND phone_verified_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT user_id, phonenumber FROM sys_user WHERE phonenumber IS NOT NULL AND phonenumber <> ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_aftersale_participant_user(case_id, user_id) VALUES(#{caseId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_handover WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND handover_type = 'OWNER_TO_DRIVER' AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT decision, approved_fen, opinion, public_opinion, reviewer_user_id, DATE_FORMAT(reviewed_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') reviewed_iso FROM vi_aftersale_review WHERE case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY revision
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_aftersale_case SET case_status = #{caseStatus}, review_status = #{reviewStatus}, approved_fen = #{approvedFen}, return_state = #{returnState}, refund_state = #{refundState}, public_opinion = #{publicOpinion}, resolved_at = CASE WHEN #{caseStatus} IN ('CLOSED', 'REJECTED') THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND case_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND review_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_aftersale_review( case_id, revision, decision, approved_fen, observed_order_version, custody_at_review, return_required, reviewer_user_id, opinion, public_opinion, reviewed_at ) VALUES( #{row.id}, #{row.reviewRevision}, #{decision}, #{row.approvedFen}, #{orderVersion}, #{custody}, #{returnRequired}, #{reviewer}, #{opinion}, #{row.publicOpinion}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_payment_order SET refund_reserved_fen = refund_reserved_fen + #{amount}, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND paid_fen - refunded_fen - refund_reserved_fen >= #{amount}

UPDATE vi_order SET cancel_status =
'APPROVED_WAIT_RETURN' 'COMPLETED' ,
fulfillment_status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), active_assignment_id = NULL,
version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND cancel_status = 'APPLIED'
UPDATE vi_order SET cancel_status = 'NONE', version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND cancel_status = 'APPLIED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, driver_id FROM vi_dispatch_invite WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'WAIT_RESPONSE' ORDER BY driver_id, id FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, driver_id FROM vi_driver_assignment WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY driver_id, id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_dispatch_invite SET status = 'REVOKED', responded_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'WAIT_RESPONSE'

UPDATE vi_driver_assignment SET ended_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), end_reason = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND ended_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, slot_id, quantity, status FROM vi_quota_reservation WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY slot_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_quota_reservation SET status = 'RELEASED', expires_at = NULL, released_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{status}
